instruction: Create a keyboard shortcut "ctrl+shift+p" to open the command palette in VS Code only when the terminal has focus.

metadata.explanation: Task requires creating a keyboard shortcut ctrl+shift+p to execute workbench.action.showCommands command when terminal has focus. The evaluator checks if this keybinding exists in the keybindings.json file. This is similar to the original task in complexity - creating a single keyboard shortcut with a specific key combination, command, and when condition.
